metadata.title: Hypersender: WhatsApp and SMS APIs
metadata.description: Hypersender is a powerful API for sending WhatsApp and SMS messages. It is designed to be simple and easy to use, with a focus on security and reliability.

hero.title: We provide WhatsApp and SMS API
hero.description: Engage with your customers without the high costs and limitations of Paid WhatsApp Business API and traditional SMS providers.

features.title: Hypersender is a Developer-friendly API for integrations
features.subtitle: The multifunctional API for WhatsApp and SMS, ideal for businesses and developers. It seamlessly integrates with any accounting system, CRM, ERP, or website for messaging, user notifications, and beyond.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp API
whatsapp.description: Send and receive messages, images, videos, and documents using the WhatsApp API. Our API is designed to be simple and easy to use.

sms.title: SMS API
sms.description: Send and receive SMS messages using our powerful SMS API. Works with all carriers on your own phone number.

otpRequest.title: Request OTP Code
otpRequest.description: Send OTPs over WhatsApp or SMS with configurable length, charset, TTL, and sender name.

otpLink.title: Generate OTP Link
otpLink.description: Generate WhatsApp links with callbacks for success or failure to power seamless login flows.

secondaryFeatures.title: Hypersender is not just an API, it's a platform
secondaryFeatures.subtitle: Get a taste of what Hypersender can do for you

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Hypersender provides uptime and performance monitoring for your Android phone (SMS) and WhatsApp. Get real-time notifications when your phone is offline.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Hypersender integrates easily with your favorite programming tools and even external services like Zapier and more.

searchability.title: Searchability
searchability.description: Search your WhatsApp messages by date, sender, content, message type or even what device it was sent from!

otp.title: OTP Authentication
otp.description: Send secure one-time passwords via WhatsApp or SMS for user authentication, password resets, and transaction verification with built-in verification endpoints.
